theorem ownStepGhost_ns_last [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ⊢ ownStepGhost γ md c id s -∗
    ⌜s.gh.ns = true → s.role = PRole.leader → 2 ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.logst.prev (s.logst.sents ++
    s.logst.uents)⌝ ∗ ownStepGhost γ md c id s

theorem GMode.dyn.congr_simp (dec dec✝ : CCDec) (e_dec : dec = dec✝) (c0 c0✝ : CCState) (e_c0 : c0 =
    c0✝) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g g✝ : RGh) (e_g : g = g✝) : GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g = GMode.dyn dec✝ c0✝ ⋯
    g✝

theorem snapOkIf_of_cert [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (id : w64) (ps : PState) (sv : SnapshotM) (scfg : CSLists) (Hcl : scfg =
    sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id ps md.isDyn -∗ raftSnapCert γ (snapTrip sv
    scfg) -∗ GMode.SnapOkIf γ id md sv scfg ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id ps md.isDyn

def GMove (m : MessageM) (s s' : NState) (g g' : RGh) : Prop :=
  m.Type' = MsgSnap ∧
      g'.cidx = g.cidx ∧ g'.cfg = g.cfg ∧ g.decs ⊆ g'.decs ∧ (s'.role = PRole.preCandidate → g'.fp = g.fp) ∨
    g' = g ∨
      m.Type' = MsgStorageApplyResp ∧
          g' = { cidx := max g.cidx (uint.nat s'.logst.applied), cfg := g.cfg, fp := g.fp, decs := g.decs } ∨
        m.Type' = MsgStorageAppendResp ∧
          s'.logst.applied ≠ s.logst.applied ∧ g'.fp = g.fp ∧ g'.decs = g.decs ∧ g'.cidx = uint.nat s'.logst.applied

theorem ghost_stepCDS [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c c' : CfgM) (id : w64) (m : MessageM) (Hms : m.Type' = MsgSnap) (sv :
    SnapshotM) (scfg : CSLists) (s : NState) (recv : List Msg) (s' : NState) (a : Msg) (Ha : a.ty =
    MsgType.snap ∧ { term' := a.logterm, index' := a.index } = snapId sv) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^
    64) (Hstep : StepCDS c c' (snapCfg sv scfg) (scfg.Has id) id B (snapId sv) s recv s') (Hc' : c'
    = c ∨ c' = snapCfg sv scfg ∧ scfg.Has id) (Hng : s'.gh = s.gh ∧ s'.logst.storage =
    s.logst.storage) : ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ isMessage γ a -∗ ([∗list] x ∈ recv,
    isMessage γ x) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗ GMode.SnapOkIf γ id md sv
    scfg -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s) md.isDyn -∗ ghostRest γ md c id s ={⊤}=∗ ∃ md',
    ⌜md.StepOut c id m s s' md'⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s') md'.isDyn ∗ ghostRest γ md' c' id
    s'

theorem ownRaftGhost_cmt [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (id : w64) (ps : PState) {md : Bool} : ownRaftGhost γ id ps md ⊢ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk
    ps.base fp⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp ∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp ps)

def GMode.SnapOkIf [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) : GMode → SnapshotM → CSLists → IProp
    GF :=
  match x✝², x✝¹, x✝ with
  | GMode.static, sv, scfg =>
    iprop(⌜scfg.Has id →
          listToSet scfg.voters = γ.reCfg ∧
            scfg.outgoing = [] ∧
              ∀ (T : GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → (snapCfg sv scfg).voters ∪ (snapCfg sv scfg).learners ⊆ T⌝)
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g, sv, scfg => raftSnapCert γ (snapTrip sv scfg)

theorem ownStepGhost_absorb [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g : RGh) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s :
    NState) (M : DecMap) : decLb γ M ∗ ownStepGhost γ (GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g) c id s ⊢ ownStepGhost
    γ (GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 { cidx := g.cidx, cfg := g.cfg, fp := g.fp, decs := g.decs ∪ M }) c id s

theorem ghostRest_certLink [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ghostRest γ md c id s ⊢ certLink γ
    s.gh.sn ∗ ghostRest γ md c id s

def GMode.StepOut (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (m : MessageM) (s s' : NState) (md' : GMode) :
    Prop :=
  match md with
  | GMode.static => md' = GMode.static ∧ ∃ B recv, StepC c id B (toPState s) recv (toPState s')
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g =>
    ∃ g',
      GMove m s s' g g' ∧
        md' = GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g' ∧
          ∃ B recv, StepR (AdmFold (effDec dec g'.decs) c0) (effDec dec g'.decs) id B (rOf s g) recv (rOf s' g')

theorem NsLink.boot [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {γ : RaftNames} {s : NState} (H :
    NsLink γ s) (h : s.gh.ns = true) : γ.reBoot ≠ []

theorem StepR.commit_mono [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {Adm : List EntryM → CCState →
    Prop} {dec : CCDec} {id : w64} {B : Int} {r : RState} {recv : List Msg} {r' : RState} (H : StepR
    Adm dec id B r recv r') : uint.Z r.p.commit ≤ uint.Z r'.p.commit

theorem ownStepGhost_congr [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) {s s' : NState} (hp : toPState s' = toPState s)
    (ha : s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) (hs : s'.logst.snap = s.logst.snap) (hpci : pciR s' =
    pciR s) (hg : s'.gh.ns = s.gh.ns := by rfl) (hxw : s'.gh.xw = s.gh.xw := by rfl) (hld : s'.lead
    = s.lead := by rfl) (hst : s'.gh.sn = s.gh.sn := by rfl) : ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢
    ownStepGhost γ md c id s'

theorem certLink_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (sn : StorNames) : Persistent
    (certLink γ sn)

theorem ownStepGhost_xw_record [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ
    : RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) (Hl : s.lead ≠ W64 0) :
    ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢ ownStepGhost γ md c id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead :=
    s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking :=
    s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log, logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals, prevote
    := s.prevote, gh :=
          have __src := s.gh;
          { outlb := __src.outlb, unst := __src.unst, tc := __src.tc, ns := __src.ns,
            xw := insert (s.lead, s.term) s.gh.xw, slent := __src.slent, snp := __src.snp, sn := __src.sn },
        rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }

    SnapshotM) (scfg : CSLists) : Persistent (GMode.SnapOkIf γ id md sv scfg)

theorem ghost_stepCDM [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (m : MessageM) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (s :
    NState) (recv : List Msg) (s' : NState) (Hstep : StepCD c id B m s recv s') (Hdh : ∀ (dec :
    CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g : RGh), md = GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g → ∀ (d' : CCDec),
    RInv d' c0 (rOf s g) → DynHyp (effDec dec g.decs) m s s' g) : ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗
    ([∗list] x ∈ recv, isMessage γ x) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s) md.isDyn -∗ ghostRestM γ md c id s ={⊤}=∗ ∃ md', ⌜md.StepOut c id
    m s s' md'⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s') md'.isDyn ∗ ghostRestM γ md' c id s'

def xfW (γ : RaftNames) (s : NState) : IProp GF :=
  [∗map] p ↦ _u ∈ s.gh.xw, isLeader γ p.fst p.snd

theorem ownStepGhost_dyn [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g : RGh) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : ownStepGhost γ (GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g) c id s ⊣⊢ ⌜γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0
    h0) ∧ g.cfg.cfg = c ∧ NsLink γ s⌝ ∗ decLb γ g.decs ∗ ownRaftGhostR γ (effDec dec g.decs) c0 id
    (rOf s g) ∗ certLink γ s.gh.sn ∗ leadW γ id (toPState s) ∗ xfW γ s

theorem ownStepGhost_mode [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢
    ⌜γ.reDyn.isSome = md.isDyn⌝ ∗ ownStepGhost γ md c id s

inductive GMode : Type
  | GMode.static : GMode
  | GMode.dyn (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g : RGh) : GMode

    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢
    raftCommitInv γ

    RaftNames) {t t' i i' : w64} (ht : t = t') (hi : i = i') : ackIn γ t i ⊢ ackIn γ t' i'

theorem GMode.Pre.dynHyp [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {md : GMode} {m : MessageM} {ents
    : List EntryM} {s s' : NState} (h : md.Pre m ents s) (Hns : m.Type' ≠ MsgSnap) (Hap : m.Type' =
    MsgStorageApplyResp → s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied ∨ ∃ e, ents.getLast? = some e ∧
    s'.logst.applied = w64Max e.Index' s.logst.applied) {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {h0 : CfgOk c0}
    {g : RGh} (hmd : md = GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g) {d' : CCDec} (HI : RInv d' c0 (rOf s g)) : DynHyp
    (effDec dec g.decs) m s s' g

def ghostRestM [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) : GMode → CfgM → w64 → NState → IProp GF :=
  match x✝³, x✝², x✝¹, x✝ with
  | GMode.static, c, id, x => iprop(⌜CfgStatic γ c ∧ TrackedOk γ c id⌝)
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g, c, id, s =>
    iprop(⌜γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0) ∧ g.cfg.cfg = c ∧ RInv (effDec dec g.decs) c0 (rOf s g)⌝ ∗
        decLb γ g.decs ∗ logRecs γ base0 g.fp ∗ ∀ x, isCampK γ id (toPState s).term (rOf s g).full (toPState s).commit)

theorem GMode.StepOut.commit_mono [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {md : GMode} {c : CfgM}
    {id : w64} {m : MessageM} {s s' : NState} {md' : GMode} (H : md.StepOut c id m s s' md') :
    uint.Z s.logst.committed ≤ uint.Z s'.logst.committed

theorem ownStepGhost_lead [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢ □
    (⌜s.lead ≠ W64 0⌝ -∗ isLeader γ s.lead s.term) ∗ ownStepGhost γ md c id s

def GMode.Guard (md : GMode) (s : NState) : Prop :=
  match md with
  | GMode.static => True
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g => PreGuardF g.fp s

theorem storCertOk_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (sn : StorNames) :
    Persistent (storCertOk γ sn)

theorem ghostRest_voters_ne [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ghostRest γ md c id s ⊢ ⌜s.role =
    PRole.leader → c.voters ≠ ∅⌝ ∗ ghostRest γ md c id s

theorem ghost_stepCDSM [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c c' : CfgM) (id : w64) (m : MessageM) (Hms : m.Type' = MsgSnap) (sv :
    SnapshotM) (scfg : CSLists) (s : NState) (recv : List Msg) (s' : NState) (a : Msg) (Ha : a.ty =
    MsgType.snap ∧ { term' := a.logterm, index' := a.index } = snapId sv) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^
    64) (Hstep : StepCDS c c' (snapCfg sv scfg) (scfg.Has id) id B (snapId sv) s recv s') (Hc' : c'
    = c ∨ c' = snapCfg sv scfg ∧ scfg.Has id) : ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ isMessage γ a -∗
    ([∗list] x ∈ recv, isMessage γ x) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗
    GMode.SnapOkIf γ id md sv scfg -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s) md.isDyn -∗ ghostRestM γ md c
    id s ={⊤}=∗ ∃ md', ⌜md.StepOut c id m s s' md'⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s') md'.isDyn ∗
    ghostRestM γ md' c' id s'

theorem ghost_stepCD [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (m : MessageM) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (s :
    NState) (recv : List Msg) (s' : NState) (Hstep : StepCD c id B m s recv s') (Hdh : ∀ (dec :
    CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (g : RGh), md = GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g → ∀ (d' : CCDec),
    RInv d' c0 (rOf s g) → DynHyp (effDec dec g.decs) m s s' g) (Hng : s'.gh = s.gh ∧
    s'.logst.storage = s.logst.storage) : ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ ([∗list] x ∈ recv,
    isMessage γ x) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (toPState s) md.isDyn -∗ ghostRest γ md c id s ={⊤}=∗ ∃ md', ⌜md.StepOut c id m s s' md'⌝ ∗
    ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s') md'.isDyn ∗ ghostRest γ md' c id s'

theorem ownStepGhost_nsLink [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ownStepGhost γ md c id s ⊢ ⌜NsLink
    γ s⌝ ∗ ownStepGhost γ md c id s

def NsLink (γ : RaftNames) (s : NState) : Prop :=
  s.gh.ns = γ.reNoSnap

def GMode.isDyn : GMode → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | GMode.static => false
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g => true

def raftCertN (γ : RaftNames) : Namespace :=
  γ.reCertNs

theorem ownRaftGhost_ns_last [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : NState) {md : Bool} (Hnl : NsLink γ s) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id
    (toPState s) md -∗ ⌜s.gh.ns = true → s.role = PRole.leader → 2 ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.logst.prev
    (s.logst.sents ++ s.logst.uents)⌝ ∗ ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s) md

theorem ghostRest_nsLink [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) : ghostRest γ md c id s ⊢ ⌜NsLink γ
    s⌝ ∗ ghostRest γ md c id s

def certLink [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (sn : StorNames) : IProp GF :=
  storCertOk γ sn

theorem GMode.StepOut.keep [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {md : GMode} {c : CfgM} {id :
    w64} {m : MessageM} {s s' : NState} {md' : GMode} (H : md.StepOut c id m s s' md') (hm : m.Type'
    ≠ MsgStorageApplyResp) (hs : m.Type' ≠ MsgSnap := by first | assumption | (intro h; simp_all) |
    decide) (ha : m.Type' = MsgStorageAppendResp → s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) : md' = md

def ownStepGhost [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownRaftGhost γ id (toPState s) md.isDyn ∗ ghostRest γ md c id s)

theorem GMode.Guard.of_nonpre [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {md : GMode} {s : NState} (h
    : md.isDyn = true → s.role ≠ PRole.preCandidate) : md.Guard s

def ghostRest [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s :
    NState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜NsLink γ s⌝ ∗ ghostRestM γ md c id s ∗ certLink γ s.gh.sn ∗ leadW γ id (toPState s) ∗ xfW γ s)

def storCertOk [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (sn : StorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((□
        ∀ sv E, ⌜↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E⌝ -∗ svCert sn sv ={E}=∗ raftSnapCertD γ (snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)) ∗
      (□ ∀ k E, ⌜↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E⌝ -∗ ksnCert sn k ={E}=∗ raftSnapCertD γ k) ∗
        □ ∀ k E, ⌜↑(raftCertN γ) ⊆ E⌝ -∗ raftSnapCertD γ k ={E}=∗ ksnCert sn k)

theorem ghostRest_keep [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ :
    RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) {s s' : NState} (hb : (toPState s').base =
    (toPState s).base) (hl : (toPState s').log = (toPState s).log) (hc : (toPState s').commit =
    (toPState s).commit) (ht : (toPState s').term = (toPState s).term) (hr : (toPState s').role =
    (toPState s).role) (ha : s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) (hs : s'.logst.snap = s.logst.snap)
    (hpci : pciR s' = pciR s) (hg : s'.gh.ns = s.gh.ns := by rfl) (hxw : s'.gh.xw = s.gh.xw := by
    rfl) (hld : s'.lead = s.lead := by rfl) (hst : s'.gh.sn = s.gh.sn := by rfl) : ghostRest γ md c
    id s ⊢ ghostRest γ md c id s'

def GMode.Pre (md : GMode) (m : MessageM) (ents : List EntryM) (s : NState) : Prop :=
  match md with
  | GMode.static => True
  | GMode.dyn dec c0 h0 g =>
    PreGuardF g.fp s ∧
      (m.Type' = MsgStorageApplyResp →
          ∀ (e : EntryM),
            ents.getLast? = some e → NoUndecConfIn (effDec dec g.decs) (rOf s g).full g.cidx (uint.nat e.Index')) ∧
        (m.Type' = MsgProp → plogLastIndexZ (toPState s).base (toPState s).log + 2 ^ 61 < 2 ^ 64)

theorem GMode.Pre.of_other [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {md : GMode} {m : MessageM}
    {ents : List EntryM} {s : NState} (_h1 : m.Type' ≠ MsgSnap) (h2 : md.Guard s) (h3 : m.Type' ≠
    MsgStorageApplyResp) (h4 : m.Type' ≠ MsgProp) : md.Pre m ents s

theorem StepC.commit_mono [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {c : CfgM} {id : w64} {B : Int}
    {ps : PState} {recv : List Msg} {ps' : PState} (H : StepC c id B ps recv ps') : uint.Z ps.commit
    ≤ uint.Z ps'.commit

theorem ownStepGhost_xferRefute [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF]
    (γ : RaftNames) (md : GMode) (c : CfgM) (id : w64) (s : NState) (T : w64) : ownStepGhost γ md c
    id s ∗ isLeader γ id T ⊢ ⌜T = s.term → s.role = PRole.follower → s.lead = W64 0⌝ ∗ ownStepGhost
    γ md c id s

theorem xfW_persistent (γ : RaftNames) (s : NState) : Persistent (xfW γ s)

theorem rOf_congr [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] {s s' : NState} (g : RGh) (hp : toPState
    s' = toPState s) (ha : s'.logst.applied = s.logst.applied) (hs : s'.logst.snap = s.logst.snap)
    (hpci : pciR s' = pciR s) : rOf s' g = rOf s g
